title: Construct a paid rational high-order pulse with nonzero shear excursion
statement: For integer p>=1 and positive rational T0,theta, put w(x)=x^(p+3)(1-x)^(p+3), h=w^(p),g=w^(p-1). Select first j=1,...,p+9 with g(j/(p+10))!=0, which exists because degree g=p+7. Set x*=j/(p+10) and A(t)=theta h(t/T0)/(T0 g(x*)). Then A,A_prime,A_doubleprime vanish at both ends, integral t^r A=0 for every r<p, and cumulative integral at x*T0 equals theta. Thus this is a genuine nonzero-excursion pulse with ordinary rational coefficients and degree p+6. Derivative coefficient sum<=2^(p+3)(2p+6)^p and nonzero grid value>= (p+10)^[-(p+7)] give absolute action<=Lambda_p theta and peak<=Lambda_p theta/T0 for Lambda_p=(4p+40)^(4p+20). Coefficient bit length O(p(L+log p)); generating the ordinary list is polynomial in NUMERICAL p and complete parameter/output bits. No free work in log p or physical common-controller theorem is asserted.
